checks.text: With no zones added, the list area shows the text "No zones yet".

Typing "New York" in the field labelled "Zone name" and clicking the button "Add zone" adds a list item that contains "New York" and a time display showing the current time in the America/New_York zone; the text "No zones yet" is gone.

After adding "New York", typing "Tokyo" in the field labelled "Zone name" and clicking "Add zone" adds a second list item containing "Tokyo" and a time display showing the current time in the Asia/Tokyo zone.
Every list item has a button named "Remove <zone name>". With "New York" and "Tokyo" added, clicking "Remove Tokyo" removes that item, leaving only "New York" in the list.

Clicking the button "Copy times" copies a multi-line string to the clipboard where the first line is "New York: " followed by the current HH:MM:SS time in America/New_York, and the second line is "Tokyo: " followed by the current HH:MM:SS time in Asia/Tokyo.

Clicking the tab labelled "Offsets" switches to a second view that shows a table with a column labelled "Zone" and a column labelled "UTC offset"; the row for "New York" shows the offset text "UTC-05:00" (or "UTC-04:00" depending on DST) and the row for "Tokyo" shows "UTC+09:00".
In the "Offsets" view, clicking the column header "Zone" sorts the table rows alphabetically by zone name, so "New York" appears before "Tokyo".
Reload keeps the added zones: after adding "New York" and "Tokyo" and reloading the page, the list still shows both "New York" and "Tokyo" with their live time displays.
